title: Diagnostics Return Query Data
purpose: Exercise Diagnostics function 0x08 with subfunction 0x0000 using a small nonzero query value to cover echo-style handling.
expected_behavior: Server should parse a valid Diagnostics request with subfunction 0x0000 and typically echo the 0x1234 data value in the response, or return an exception if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x0006 for unit_id plus 5-byte Diagnostics PDU.
Function code 0x08 is used for Diagnostics.
The first two data bytes after function code contain subfunction 0x0000.
The remaining two bytes carry query data 0x1234.
issue_safety_notes: Diagnostics coverage is retained in a single stronger seed rather than many near-duplicate counter queries.
